paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : GPT-4o-mini
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the informativeness scores for two methods, 0-CoT and CoRe, across four different levels (0 to 4) on the x-axis, which is labeled numerically from 0 to 4 with a linear scale and tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled "Informativeness," ranges from approximately 0.910 to 0.950, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.010. The 0-CoT method is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, while the CoRe method is shown as an orange solid line with triangular markers. At level 0, both methods start at an informativeness score of approximately 0.950. From level 0 to level 1, both lines remain nearly constant, with slight decreases: 0-CoT drops to about 0.949 and CoRe to about 0.948. From level 1 to level 4, both lines show a consistent downward trend. At level 2, 0-CoT reaches approximately 0.940 and CoRe reaches about 0.939. At level 3, 0-CoT is around 0.923 and CoRe is approximately 0.922. At level 4, both lines end at approximately 0.918. Throughout the entire range, the CoRe line remains slightly above the 0-CoT line, indicating marginally higher informativeness at each level.
